ground_truth: The trace witness's _database() lazy initialiser sets self._db_resolved = True before assigning self._db. A second thread arriving while the MongoClient is still being constructed sees the resolved flag already True, returns self._db - which has not been assigned yet - and its events are silently skipped. There is no lock around the initialisation. The fix is to lock the initialisation and set the resolved flag last, after the handle is assigned.
